rule: the frozen tool table is not finished and this turn produced no valid Action; a Final Answer marker is not required (it is sufficient, not necessary)

c_zero_triggers_on_non_plugin_arms.explanation: the rule is only consulted when a guard state is installed and enabled; the non-plugin arms carry none, and their recorded ledgers show zero guard activity.  Their closing turns are bare handoffs too, so the rule *would* refuse them if it were wrongly installed -- that is exactly the arm-scoping error this check rules out

d_expected_rejections_on_the_recorded_se.note: the floor adds one refusal per action-less early stop, because the recorded r16 sequence under the v16 rule never refused them; any further refusal depends on how the model answers the control message, which the r16 record cannot show
